title: API Security and Spring Review
description: Session cookies versus JWTs, password hashing, issuing and checking a JWT, role-protected endpoints, a dev profile that keeps endpoints open for front-end work, common API security risks from the OWASP API Security Top 10 (the S12 required lab and the FT7 project brief), and the Spring review.
sourceCoverageNotes: Course slice: Standard S1-S13 and Fast FT1-FT8. This module covers Standard S12-S13.
S12 carries calendar requiredLab true: the planned module coding lab (Standard lab overlay) is required there.
FT7 (calendar Lab, requiredLab true) is presented on the Fast track as Project implementation: its six rows map 'shared' to their canonical topics and to the project brief api-security-project.

S13 row 0 and FT8 row 2 map to the review page; S13 row 1 and FT8 row 3 'Spring module check' map to the course-level blueprint spring-boot/assessments/spring-boot-module-check, never to a learner topic.
